correctness.rationale: The face predicate was checked both through an exact forbidden-triple recurrence and independent exhaustive connected-component traversal for all 262144 subsets. The deterministic Morse matching has 10320 cover pairs and all 120222 directed nonempty Hasse incidences were topologically sorted, certifying acyclicity. Signed integer gradient reductions give nine exact zero attaching degrees; by Hurewicz for the 4-connected wedge of nine 5-spheres the last attaching map is null. The result is finite with no extrapolation; full executable path supplied.

Published record ff7e4637c061 concerns ordinary independence (no induced edge), not Ind_2, and db6c6c11f317 concerns a matching complex on edges. value.rationale: The 18-vertex Pappus graph is a canonical distance-regular cubic symmetric Levi graph. Its 2-independence/3-path-free complex tests topology outside tree or complete-multipartite classifications. An exact full integral homotopy type, with simultaneously nine S^5 summands and one S^6 summand, is a natural high-dimensional benchmark for future general structural methods. The result is stronger than an Euler characteristic/field-homology table and specific enough to be independently reproduced.
